acceptance: Development diagnostics only; transcription review does not accept these measurements as a public release or merge gate.
date_basis: UTC time the development milestone was first documented in its change proposal; not measurement completion time. Chart spacing follows recorded order, not elapsed duration.

group.hardware: Exact model is not attested in these retained gate summaries.
group.method: Reported single-round development diagnostics using per-query wall medians and retained Polars references. Exact historical warmup/sample compatibility is not established by these summaries. Geometric means are reported values; missing final-run values remain null.
group.reference_scope: Historical Development Mini reference medians. The retained input documentation says the sampling-compatibility audit and operator decision were outstanding; corrected collector code does not retroactively certify these runs.
group.limits: Development diagnostics, not audited corrected-protocol receipts, paired gains versus main, or release qualification. The development gate allowed noise-triggered retries; values are rounded transcriptions, not recomputations from private raw samples.

milestones.title: Dense group IDs
milestones.lesson: Compact group IDs avoid encoding text keys for every joined row. q16 fell from 0.245 s to 0.166 s. The host was slightly busy; this was one timing round.

milestones.title: Radix COUNT DISTINCT
milestones.lesson: Sorting funded (group, value) pairs replaces a hash set per group. q16 fell from 0.166 s to 0.098 s. Output ordering and memory bounds still need protection.

milestones.title: Reuse filtered scans
milestones.lesson: Retain a bounded filtered result instead of rescanning. The final reviewed-fix run reported q17 at 0.251 s and total 1.234×; earlier attempts are not substituted.

milestones.title: Use actual row counts
milestones.lesson: Actual row counts can unlock an optimization that estimates reject. The corrected run was 1.187× total with q21 at 0.585 s; the initial 1.177× result is not the final value. Memory funding matters as much as admission.

milestones.title: Dynamic scan claiming
milestones.lesson: Let workers claim row groups dynamically while retaining source order. q04 fell from 0.261 s to 0.202 s. Runnable permits and live-thread limits are different resource obligations.

milestones.title: Pipeline continuations
milestones.lesson: Workers resubmit continuations to avoid coordinator waits. q01 reached 0.761 s. The measured worktree was committed with an identical tree, but no binary rebuild/hash comparison was performed.

provisional.title: Combined source · provisional M4 run
provisional.configuration: 10 logical CPUs, 16 GiB RAM, macOS 26.6.2; Rust 1.90.0; no custom RUSTFLAGS. Assay 4 GiB accounted budget; Polars streaming; resource limits are not equivalent whole-process caps.
provisional.protocol: Three rotated rounds; one warmup and five timed samples per engine/query/round. Total sums query-round medians; geometric mean uses paired query ratios.
provisional.lesson: The combined source was below Polars in total time but above it in geometric mean. The 0.95× goal for both metrics was not met. This single attempt is separate from the Test Mini runs.
provisional.limits: Quiet-host admission sampled six five-second intervals before launch; the harness did not continuously record background processes. One attempt; no independent acceptance or hardware portability claim.

starting_benchmark.title: Starting benchmark · Alpha 2-equivalent native source
starting_benchmark.date_basis: Date of published historical benchmark report, not elapsed development time.
starting_benchmark.method: SQL to materialized Arrow; three rounds, one warmup then five hot samples per engine/query/round. Total is ratio of sums over query-round medians; geometric mean uses paired query-round ratios.
starting_benchmark.limits: Best-effort host with background activity; native CLI, not installed Python wheel/API. Distinct from the historical M4 4.1364× result and later Development Mini diagnostics; no controlled cross-host gain is claimed.
